# discord_emoji_collection (Resource)

Manages an ordered collection of guild emojis. Uploads and verifies each entry sequentially in block order. Only recorded IDs are deleted. Do not also manage those IDs with individual resources. Discord does not expose picker positions or remote image hashes. Independent collections can run concurrently; use one collection per expression type or explicit depends_on. Import format: server_id:key=id,key=id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_local_image" "emoji" {
  for_each = toset(["barbarian", "wizard", "salute"])
  file     = "${path.module}/emojis/${each.key}.png"
}

resource "discord_emoji_collection" "star" {
  server_id         = var.server_id
  rebuild_on_change = true

  # Blocks upload sequentially, from top to bottom.
  emoji {
    key   = "barbarian"
    name  = "star_barbarian"
    image = data.discord_local_image.emoji["barbarian"].data_uri
  }

  emoji {
    key   = "wizard"
    name  = "star_wizard"
    image = data.discord_local_image.emoji["wizard"].data_uri
  }

  emoji {
    key      = "templar_salute"
    name     = "star_templar_salute"
    image    = data.discord_local_image.emoji["salute"].data_uri
    role_ids = [discord_role.templar.id]
  }
}

output "barbarian_emoji_id" {
  value = discord_emoji_collection.star.ids["barbarian"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) Guild ID. Changing it replaces the collection.

### Optional

- `emoji` (Block List) Entries in upload order. All existing managed entries are deleted before any replacement is uploaded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--emoji))
- `rebuild_on_change` (Boolean) Explicitly permit deleting ALL managed entries before sequential recreation when entries, order, artwork, or observed metadata change. Default false refuses such changes. IDs change, existing references may become invalid, and rate limits may make the collection unavailable for an extended period. Never use create_before_destroy.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Hash of ordered configuration and local artwork. Cleared on observed drift or partial failure so a subsequent plan repairs the collection.
- `id` (String) Collection identifier (server ID and expression type).
- `ids` (Map of String) Discord IDs indexed by stable entry key. Partial failures retain successful uploads for cleanup on the next apply.

<a id="nestedblock--emoji"></a>
### Nested Schema for `emoji`

Required:

- `image` (String) Base64 image data URI, for example discord_local_image.data_uri, up to 256 KiB decoded. Image changes rebuild the collection.
- `key` (String) Unique stable key used in the ids map. Changing it rebuilds the collection.
- `name` (String) Discord expression name.

Optional:

- `role_ids` (Set of String) Roles allowed to use this emoji; omitted or empty allows everyone.
